mostWorthwhile.text: The closing image of a sea assembled through unplanned natural processes was a worthwhile conclusion to the history.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter had no gameplay actions, so there was no decision to assess.

surprise.text: The ending’s emphasis that none of these processes was aiming at a sea gave the preceding story a useful perspective.

arbitrary.text: There were no actions in the final chapter to judge as arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue for more explanations of natural processes, though this chapter offered no gameplay to judge how engaging further decisions would be.
